context: Compose source, bindings, design and schema as a version 1 package. Source is plain data; design holds appearance.
Schema maps interface names to kind: object and properties. Each property has type: {kind: string} and optional: false.
A form binding maps a root.viewNode to a source address and schema type. View addresses and state addresses differ.
collection sets address, idField, typeField, propertiesField, labelField, subtitleFields, nodePrefix and types.
Design version 1 needs defaults, types, nodes and mapping: {version: 1, fields: []}. Put icons and colors here.
Use edge-create with source, target, sourceProperty and targetProperty. Match schema ports. Auto mode shows all edges.
bindings.dependencies maps a source dependency-array field to output:name and input:name ports. References use stable IDs.
design.mapping.fields selects {type, field} for sharing. Referencing one resource shares edits. Export resolves values.
Use executionId and requestId. form-schema installs types; form-set edits values; configuration-replace applies a package.
Command replies confirm publication only. Inspect/export results arrive in browser squeed:mcp-result events, not MCP replies.
